bare_find_and_delete.comment: Bare script spend built to exercise FindAndDelete: the eight multisig signatures appear as pushes inside the scriptPubKey itself, so the legacy SIGHASH_ALL scriptCode must have them deleted. The other eight sigs per CHECKMULTISIG ride the SIGHASH_SINGLE bug (input index 1, one output).

p2pk_high_s.note: block 707: pre-BIP62 signature with a high S value; consensus-valid, so verification must normalize S the way Core does

p2pkh_non_strict_der.note: block 170065: R is encoded with its high bit set (negative-looking, not strict DER) and S is high; both are consensus-valid pre-BIP66, and Core parses every signature laxly

p2sh_p2wpkh_nonstandard_sighash_byte.note: Mined at height 508011 with sighash type byte 0x65: BIP143 serializes the raw byte, so canonicalizing it to SIGHASH_ALL before hashing breaks the signature.

p2tr_script_codeseparator.note: Mined at height 925565: 160 CHECKSIGVERIFYs, each after an OP_CODESEPARATOR. The tapscript sighash commits to the codeseparator opcode index (BIP342 opcode_pos), not its byte offset.
